docs.title: Welcome to the Nameless Trinkets Wiki!
docs.text:
This wiki is your go-to source for everything related to Nameless Trinkets. Here, you'll find details about mechanics, item effects, and the most relevant information.

If you notice any outdated, incomplete information or think something should be expanded, feel free to reach out! You can contact me on Discord: Join here.

docs.title: Common Config
docs.text:
This is the configuration you can find in 📂 config/nameless_trinkets-common.toml.

Global Loot Multiplier

  • "globalLootMultiplier": A multiplier to globally adjust the drop rates of all trinkets.

Enable Trinket Crafting

  • "enableTrinketCrafting": Enables or disables all crafting recipes for trinkets. Valus from 0.0 to 1.0.

Fragments from Trinket Destruction

  • "getFragments": Decides whether you get an Unknown Fragment when recycling a trinket.
The following configuration is currently removed but will be reintroduced in the future.

New Trinket Slot Probability

  • "newSlotProbability": It is the probability when using a Mysterious Trinkets of obtaining a new Trinket slot.

Trinket Slot Settings

  • "maxTrinketSlots": The maximum number of Trinket slots obtainable.
  • "startingSlotQuantity": The initial number of Trinket slots at the start of the game.

docs.title: Can I disable trinkets?
docs.text: Answer: Yes, trinkets effects can be disabled through the configuration files. (This feature is available from version v1.7.0 onwards.)

docs.title: The "X" trinket is too powerful, could you nerf it?
docs.text: Answer: In general, no. Unless there's a very specific case, I don't make nerfs. However, you can easily adjust its stats through the configuration files.

docs.title: Is it possible to modify the stats of trinkets?
docs.text: Answer: Yes, each trinket has its own configuration file, so feel free to customize them as you like!

docs.title: Can I change the number of trinket slots or the percentage of the Mysterious Trinket?
docs.text: Answer: Yes, both the number of trinket slots and the Mysterious Trinket percentage can be adjusted via the configuration files.

docs.title: Can trinket recipes be disabled?
docs.text: Answer: Yes, you can modify or disable trinket recipes using CraftTweaker mod.

docs.title: I'm experiencing issues with max health, how can I fix it?
docs.text: Answer: You can resolve this by using the Max Health Fix mod.

docs.title: Loot Tables
docs.text:
Note

As of recent versions, trinkets have been made rarer by removing them from many loot tables. You can globally adjust their drop rates using the globalLootMultiplier option in the common configuration file.

This section covers how you can modify the loot tables that change the spawn frequency and location of trinkets.

From versions +1.21.x-1.1.x, this can be modified from the configuration found at 📂 config/nameless_trinkets/trinket_loot_configs.

Other Versions

The following versions use DataPacks, please note that they only work for Forge/NeoForge (If you use version 1.9.x it works the same as above.):

Pre-1.7.x

  • 1.19.x

  • 1.20.x

Post-1.8.x

  • 1.19.x

  • 1.20.x

Post-1.21
  • 1.21.x
Fabric

There is no way to edit loot tables in Fabric before version 1.21.x-1.1.x.

docs.title: How to obtain trinkets
docs.text:
Trinkets can be acquired in different ways:

  • Chest Loot: Trinkets can be found in various chests throughout the world. While they are not guaranteed to appear, their spawn rate can be configured:

    • (Pre-1.7.x)

      • 1.20: TBD
      • 1.19.x: TBD

    • (Post-1.8.x)

      • TBD

    • (Post-1.21)

      • TBD

  • Crafting: Trinkets can also be crafted. You can use JEI to view the recipes.

  • Mysterious Trinket: Using this item grants you a random trinket.

docs.title: Recycling Trinkets
docs.text: Unwanted or duplicate Trinkets can be recycled to obtain Unknown Fragments.

docs.title: How to Obtain Unknown Fragments
docs.text:
• Right-click a Trinket on an Amethyst Block to break it down into Unknown Fragments.
  • If the Amethyst Block is unavailable in your version, left-clicking a Trinket on an Enchanting Table will have the same effect.

docs.title: Crafting a Mysterious Trinket
docs.text: Once you collect 9 Unknown Fragments, you can craft a Mysterious Trinket, which grants you a random Trinket when used.

docs.title: Getting more slots
docs.text:
Currently the only way to add new slots is through the tools provided by Accessories mod.

The following is currently removed but will be reintroduced in the future.

Slots can be increased by using the Mysterious Trinket. When used, it grants a chance to unlock additional slots.

Both the success rate and the maximum number of obtainable slots can be modified in nameless_trinkets-common.toml

docs.title: Tags
docs.text: Certain tags define how Trinkets behave in the mod.

docs.title: nameless_trinkets_tag.json
docs.text: 📂 Location: data/nameless_trinkets/tags/items - Determines which items the Mysterious Trinket can grant.

docs.title: recyclable_trinkets_tag.json
docs.text: 📂 Location: data/nameless_trinkets/tags/items - Specifies which items can be recycled into Unknown Fragments.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Amphibious Hands trinket grants the following effect:

  • Applies a mining speed multiplier when the player is underwater.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Mining Underwater Speed Percentage: This determines how much faster the player can mine underwater.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• The Amphibious Hands trinket works only when the player is submerged in water, as checked by the player.isEyeInFluidType method.

  • FOV settings are changed from nameless-trinkets-common.tmol.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Blaze Nucleus trinket grants the following effects:

  • When the player attacks an enemy, the enemy is set on fire for an amount of time. Also, if the player is on fire, he stops being on fire.
  • The player gains fire damage reduction.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Set Enemy in Fire Ticks: The number of fire ticks to apply to enemies when they are attacked.
  • Fire Damage Reduction Percentage: The percentage of fire damage reduction.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Blindfold trinket grants the following effect:

  • The player becomes invisible.

docs.title: Configurable Values:
docs.text: • Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.

docs.title: How it works.
docs.text:
The Broken Ankh trinket grants the following effect:

  • When the player is about to die, acts as a Totem of Undying. The trinket goes into cooldown after being used.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Cooldown: This is the time in ticks until it can be used again.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • If the player logs in or logs out, the cooldown for the trinket is handled accordingly.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Broken Magnet trinket grants the following effect:

  • Nearby objects are attracted to the player.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Range: This is the distance between blocks where it takes effect.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Callus trinket grants the following effects:

  • Reduces incoming damage of the following types:
    • General damage (everything).
    • Fall damage.
    • Cactus.
    • Falling anvils.
    • Hot floors.
    • Sweet berry bushes.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Fall Damage Reduction Percentage: This indicates when fall damage is reduced as a percentage.
  • General Damage Reduction Percentage: This indicates how much damage is reduced as a percentage.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Cracked Crown trinket grants the following effects:

  • The player gains additional modifiers to several stats:
    • Maximum Health
    • Movement Speed
    • Fly Speed
    • Attack Damage
    • Armor
    • Attack Speed
    • Armor Resistance
    • Attack Knockback
    • Knockback Resistance
    • Luck
    • Block Range
    • Entity Range
    • Step Height Addition
    • Swimming Speed

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Modifiers: Applied based on the indicated percentage.

docs.title: Note:
docs.text: • In the settings, some attributes have the value 0.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Creeper Sense trinket grants the following effect:

  • It triggers an explosion when the player crouches.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Explosion Level: The strength of the explosion.
  • Cooldown In Ticks: The amount of time, in ticks, that the trinket is on cooldown after use.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• The explosion only triggers while the player is crouching and has a block of air above them, and after it happens, the player's crouch state will be reset (i.e., the player will no longer be crouching).
  • The explosion will not interact with the environment or break blocks, as the ExplosionInteraction is set to NONE.
  • Explosion damage affects the player.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Dark Nelumbo trinket grants the following effects:

  • Allows the player to stand on lava as if it were a solid block.
  • If you press the shift key you will sink.
  • If the lava reaches your eyes you will be propelled upwards.
  • If you are on fire you stop being on fire.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: • Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • You will not take damage from the lava.

docs.title: How it Works
docs.text:
The Dragon's Eye trinket grants the following effects:

  • Applies Blindness to the player.
  • Applies to Nearby hostile enemies Glowing in a light purple color.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Blindness: Configurable duration in ticks.
  • Radius: Defines the range in blocks to detect entities.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Dying Star trinket grants the following effect:

  • Right-clicking a trinket on it will devour it and cause it to disappear. Giving the Dying Star other trinkets increases a random attribute by a random amount.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Attribute Scaling Configuration: Each attribute affected by the Dying Star can be individually configured using the following parameters:
  • Max Value: The upper limit the attribute can reach.
  • Min Increase: The minimum amount the attribute can increase when a trinket is consumed.
  • Max Increase: The maximum amount the attribute can increase when a trinket is consumed.

These values can be set for each of the following attributes:

  • Armor
  • Armor Toughness
  • Attack Damage
  • Attack Knockback
  • Attack Speed
  • Block Break Speed
  • Block Interaction Range
  • Explosion Knockback Resistance
  • Entity Interaction Range
  • Fall Damage Multiplier
  • Flying Speed
  • Knockback Resistance
  • Luck
  • Max Absorption
  • Max Health
  • Mining Efficiency
  • Movement Speed
  • Oxygen Bonus
  • Sneaking Speed
  • Submerged Mining Speed
  • Sweeping Damage Ratio
  • Water Movement Efficiency

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• Pressing Left Ctrl on the trinket's tooltip will show you all the attributes and their values.
  • Does not appear in chests.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Electric Paddle trinket grants the following effect:

  • It increases the speed of the boat when you ride it.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Boat Speed Percentage Multiplier: Adjusts the boat's speed by a set percentage.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • The boat's movement is modified based on the player's input (right, left, up, down).

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Ethereal Wings trinket grants the following effects:

  • When equipped, the player gains the ability to fly, and their flying speed is adjusted.
  • When unequipped, the player loses their flying abilities and the flying speed returns to the default value.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Flying Speed: Determines the speed at which the player flies.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• The player's flying speed is set back to the default value of 0.05F when the trinket is unequipped.
Incompatibilities

The trinket may stop working or malfunction when used with other mods that modify the flight or use it. This is because they take full control over their flight cancellation or use.

For example: if a mod indicates that flight is canceled while an item of theirs is unequipped, even if the Ethereal Wings indicate that the player can fly, the other item will be canceling it. I mention this example because I've encountered this before.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Experience Battery trinket grants the following effect:

  • Multiplies the experience dropped when the player kills an enemy.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Experience Percentage: This indicates how much more experience the entity was going to drop.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Experience Magnet trinket grants the following effect:

  • Pulls nearby experience orbs toward the player.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Range: This is the distance between blocks where it takes effect.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Explosion Proof Jacket trinket grants the following effects:

  • Reduces the damage taken from explosions.
  • After the explosion, the trinket causes the player to drop a TNT item at their location.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Blast Damage Percentage Reduction: The percentage by which the explosion damage is reduced.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• The dropped TNT item is invulnerable.
  • The explosions detected are those under the is_explosion tag.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Fate Emerald trinket grants the following effects:

  • Applies a discount boost for villagers.
  • The player gains extra hunger exhaustion every 20 ticks.
  • It cannot be unequipped until a certain amount of time has passed.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Discount Boost: It's how strong the discount will be.
  • Time Until Unequip: Determines how long the trinket stays equipped before it can be unequipped.
  • Hunger Exhaustion Rate: Determines how much hunger exhaustion the player receives per 20 ticks.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Fertilizer trinket grants the following effect:

  • Acts like Bonemeal on a large area around the player, affecting both land and underwater plants.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text: • Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• Growth particles are spawned to indicate successful activation.
  • The logic now prioritizes applying the effect to crops and saplings first.
  • It includes safety checks to prevent underwater growth too close to the surface.
  • It has a hidden 35% chance of activating again if it fails the first time.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Four Leaf Clover trinket grants the following effect:

  • When you kill an entity, it causes the entity's loot table to be rolled additional times, generating extra drops.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • extraLoots: Configurable number of extra loot drops to be generated per kill.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• This affects all types of loot, including conditional drops.
  • Each extra roll is randomized, meaning it's not a simple duplication of the initial loot.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Fractured Nullstone trinket grants the following effect:

  • Reduces a percentage of magic damage (both direct and indirect).

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Magic Damage Reduction Percentage: Determines the percentage by which magic damage is reduced.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Fragile Cloud trinket grants the following effect:

  • Modifies the player's gravity, allowing them to fall more slowly.
  • The player does not take fall damage.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text: • Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• The Moon Stone disables the Fragile Cloud effect entirely, preventing any gravity modification or cloud particles.
  • This effect is active when the player is not in water, not on the ground, and not flying.
  • The attribute modifier is applied if the player is falling at a significant speed (y < -0.3).
  • There is a particle effect that activates when you fall.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Ghast Eye trinket grants the following effects:

  • Increases the player's maximum health.
  • Killing an entity grants regeneration.
  • If the effect is already active, the duration is extended.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Regeneration Time: The base duration of the regeneration effect applied on kill.
  • Regeneration Level: The level of the regeneration effect applied on kill.
  • Regeneration Extra Time: The amount of time added to the regeneration effect if the player already has it.
  • Extra Hearts: The extra health added to the player’s max health.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Gills trinket grants the following effects:

  • Allows the player to breathe underwater indefinitely.
  • If the player is out of water the air supply will gradually decrease, if the player runs out of air completely they will take damage and Blindness.
  • The trinket can only be removed underwater.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Blindness When Choking: This setting determines whether the player is inflicted with blindness when their air supply is depleted.
  • Choking Damage: This specifies how much damage the player will take when their air supply is depleted.
  • Air Reduction Speed: The rate at which the player’s air supply depletes when outside of water.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The God's Crown trinket grants the following effect:

  • The player gains additional modifiers to several stats:
    • Maximum Health
    • Movement Speed
    • Fly Speed
    • Attack Damage
    • Armor
    • Attack Speed
    • Armor Resistance
    • Attack Knockback
    • Knockback Resistance
    • Luck
    • Block Range
    • Entity Range
    • Step Height Addition
    • Swimming Speed

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Modifiers: Applied based on the indicated percentage.

docs.title: Note:
docs.text:
• In the settings, some attributes have the value 0.
  • Does not appear in chests.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Ice Cube trinket grants the following effects:

  • When dealing damage, affected entities are applied Slowness.
  • When walking, nearby water blocks turn into Frosted Ice.
  • The player becomes immune to freezing damage.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Slowness Time: The duration of the slowness effect applied to the entity when the player attacks.
  • Slowness Level: The level of the slowness effect.
  • Frost Walker Level: The level of frost walker the player has, determining the radius for frosted ice creation.
  • Inmune to Freezing: Whether the player is immune to freeze damage.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Light Gloves trinket grants the following effect:

  • It modifies the player's mining speed when not under the sky.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Mining Speed Percentage: Determines the degree to which the player's mining speed is increased.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • Only applies when the sky is not visible, i.e. check the block above the player.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Lucky Rock trinket grants the following effect:

  • Gives players a chance to obtain random items when breaking Stone Blocks or blocks listed in "Block List".

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Percentage of Obtaining: The probability that the player will receive an item upon breaking a stone block.
  • Item List: A list of item strings representing items that the player may receive.
  • Block List: A list of block strings representing blocks that the player can break and may receive items.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • The effect is only triggered when breaking stone blocks.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Miners Soul trinket grants the following effect:

  • When you break a block it generates loot by applying a higher enchantment level of Fortune than the current tool.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Extra Looting Level: The bonus level applied to the Fortune enchantment for generating extra loot drops.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text:
• The Miners Soul trinket will not trigger loot generation for blocks that do not have a loot table (such as entity-based blocks).
  • The Miners Soul enhances the loot generated from blocks that drop items, using the tool's Fortune enchantment and applying the extraLootingLevel bonus.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
The Missing Page trinket grants the following effect:

  • When you take damage from an entity you may deal a percentage of its maximum life as damage to nearby entities.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Activation Percentage: The chance that the trinket will activate when the player is damaged.
  • Radius in Blocks: The area around the player where valid targets can be affected.
  • Percentage of Damage: The portion of the target's maximum health that will be dealt as damage upon activation.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• The effect only applies to non-player entities that are not invulnerable.
  • When activated, soul particles are displayed around affected enemies.
  • The trinket does not trigger if the source of damage is another player.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
The Moon Stone trinket grants the following effects:

  • Modifies the player's gravity.
  • Prevents fall damage

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Gravity Value: Adjusts how much the player's gravity is modified, making them fall slower or faster.

docs.title: How it works
docs.text:
The Nelumbo trinket grants the following effects:

  • Allows the player to stand on water as if it were a solid block.
  • Pressing Shift allows the player to dive.
  • If the player dives below eye level he is propelled upwards.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: • Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text: • This trinket only works when the player is not fully submerged in water (eyes in the fluid check).

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Pocket Lightning Rod trinket grants the following effect:

  • It triggers lightning strikes during thunderstorms around the player.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Thunders: Defines the likelihood of a lightning strike occurring.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • The lightning strike happens only during rainstorms when it is thundering, and the strike location is randomized based on the chunk the player is in.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Puffer Fish Liver trinket grants the following effects:

  • Allows players to apply a poison effect to enemies when they inflict damage.
  • Prevents the player from being poisoned.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Chance to Apply Poison: The probability that the trinket will apply the Poison effect when the player inflicts damage.
  • Poison Time: The duration (in ticks) that the Poison effect lasts on the affected entity.
  • Poison Level: The level of the Poison effect, which determines the strength of the poison damage.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Rage Mind trinket grants the following effects:

  • When receiving damage from an entity the trinket marks it
  • The marked entities will glow.
  • Marked entities will take more damage from you.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Damage Multiplier Percentage: Controls how much more damage the player deals to the revenge target.
  • Range: The effective range in blocks for detecting and applying effects to revenge targets.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • The entity that the player is seeking revenge on, defined by its entity type.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Reforger trinket grants the following effect:

  • It automatically repairs any damaged items in the player's inventory after a specified time interval.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Repair Speed Seconds: Sets the time interval between each repair action.
  • Repair Quantity: Defines how much durability is restored on each repair.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • Does not affect items not in inventory, such as the armor section.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Resonant Heart trinket grants the following effect:

  • Taking damage has a chance to release a Sonic Boom.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Chance To Activate Probability: Determines the chance for the trinket to activate upon taking damage.
  • Sonic Boom Damage: Determines the damage it deals.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • As with the Warden's Sonic Boom, this only affects one entity: the attacker.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Reverse Card trinket grants the following effect:

  • Allows players to reflect the same damage back at the source.

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Chance To Activate: Determina la probabilidad de que se active el efecto.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Scarab Amulet trinket grants the following effects:

  • Grants the player a speed boost when walking on sand.
  • Prevents Husk from targeting the player.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Speed ​​Multiplier Percentage: Determines the extra speed applied.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Shrinking Veil trinket grants the following effects:

  • Decreases size.
  • Increases speed.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Shrink Scale Percentage: The percentage by which the player's size is reduced.
  • Speed ​​Percentage: The percentage of extra speed.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Sigil of Baphomet trinket grants the following effects:

  • Grants the player invulnerability to damage for a time.
  • This time increases each time the player kills an entity.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text: • Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket’s effects are active.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Sleeping Pills trinket grants the following effects:

  • Prevents the player from sleeping.
  • The player gains Night Vision and Weakness.
  • If the Phantoms get close to the player they will disappear.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Night Vision Time: Determines the amount of time in ticks that Night Vision is applied.
  • Weakness Time: Determines the amount of time in ticks that Weakness is applied.
  • Phantom Range: Distance in blocks at which Phantoms disappear.
  • Bed Disabled: Prevents players from using beds.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Speed ​​Force trinket grants the following effect:

  • Increases the player's movement speed.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Speed ​​Multiplier Percentage: The percentage increase in the player's movement speed.
  • Speed ​​Force Particles: Whether or not you want the player to release particles.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • It also generates cloud particles around the player as they move, visually representing the speed boost.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Spider Legs trinket grants the following effect:

  • It allows the player to climb the blocks vertically.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Climb Speed: Adjusts the vertical speed when the player is colliding with a surface.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Super Magnet trinket grants the following effect:

  • Attracts both nearby items and experience orbs towards the player.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Range: The distance in blocks at which it takes effect.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Tear Of The Sea trinket grants the following effect:

  • it applies a bonus swim speed boost to the player.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Swim Speed Multiplier Percentage: The percentage increase to the player's swim speed efficiency.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Tick trinket grants the following effects:

  • Applies if the entity has more than half of its life and its maximum life is more than 49.
  • causes damage to the entity.
  • The player is dealt both damage and hunger.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Range to Activate: The radius in which the trinket searches for nearby targets to apply the effect.
  • Entity Damage Percentage: The percentage of the entity's maximum health that is dealt as damage.
  • Player Damage Percentage: The percentage of the player's maximum health that is dealt as damage.
  • Player Hunger Percentage: The percentage of the player's food level used to exhaust the player when the trinket activates.

docs.title: Notes:
docs.text: • The trinket can be unequipped while the player is on fire or in creative mode.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Titan's Mark trinket grants the following effects:

  • Increases size.
  • Increases attack damage.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Extra Scale Percentage: The percentage by which the player's size is increased.
  • Attack Damage Percentage: The percentage of extra attack damage.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text: It works like a normal Bundle but only for trinkets. It stores up to a total of 64 trinkets.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The True Heart Of The Sea trinket grants the following effects:

  • If the player is underwater, the player's mining speed increases.
  • The player can breathe underwater.
  • If the player is out of the water, the player's air supply decreases and if the player is depleted, the player begins to take damage and gains Blindness.
  • It applies a bonus swim speed boost to the player.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Mining Underwater Speed Percentage: The percentage increase applied to the player's mining speed while underwater.
  • Blindness When Choking: Whether the player receives Blindness when their air supply reaches 0.
  • Choking Damage: The amount of damage dealt to the player when their air supply reaches 0.
  • Air Reduction Speed: The speed at which the air supply decreases when not in water or when in a bubble column.
  • Swim Speed Multiplier Percentage: The percentage increase to the player's swim speed efficiency.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Vampire Blood trinket grants the following effects:

  • When the player kills an entity, they heal for a percentage of the entity's maximum health.
  • The trinket makes the player vulnerable to sunlight. If the player is outside during the day and can see the sky, they take damage.
  • The trinket boosts the player's attack damage by a percentage.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Healing Percentage: The percentage of the killed entity’s maximum health that is healed.
  • Sun Damage: The amount of damage the player takes when exposed to sunlight during the day.
  • Damage Multiplier Percentage: The percentage increase in attack damage provided by the trinket.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The What Magnet trinket has the following effect:

  • The trinket causes entities near the player to be randomly repositioned. Each tick, nearby entities within a specified range are moved to a random position around the player.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Range: The effective range in blocks which nearby entities are attracted to the player.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Wooden Stick trinket grants the following effects:

  • The trinket intercepts incoming damage and completely cancels it, but this effect is subject to a cooldown period.
  • After the trinket negates damage, it enters a cooldown period during which it cannot be used again until it resets.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Cooldown: The amount of time, in ticks, that the trinket is on cooldown after use.

docs.title: How it works:
docs.text:
The Woundbearer trinket grants the following effect:

  • A percentage of the damage the player takes is stored in the trinket. Your attack damage increases based on the amount stored.

docs.title: Configuration:
docs.text:
• Is Enable: Determines whether the trinket's effect is active or not.
  • Damage Conversion Percentage: The percentage of how much damage is dealt to the player is stored in the trinket.

docs.title: Notes
docs.text:
• The accumulated damage is saved with the trinket, so it persists even if you unequip it or close the game.
  • There is a limit to the maximum damage the trinket can store which is 3.4028235 × 10^38. A lot.
